_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all four is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4), home_path_sites when every path in $HOME comes from config. `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers. NOTE 2026-08-27: content/imports/literals were re-pinned at a HIGHER measured value on this date, once, because the scan area was widened from six directories to the tracked tree and an app-content file stopped short-circuiting out of all four checks. Nobody added those lines; the gate could not previously see them. See `raised` below for the full reason, which prints on every run until each count comes back down.

content_files.because: STAGE E, FIRST HALF (2026-09-01): the backend app registry no longer enumerates apps. services/app_registry.py held eight hardcoded per-app factories and a literal _CATALOG_FACTORIES tuple listing them, so the platform module that defines what an app IS also decided which apps EXIST, and adding an app meant editing platform source. Each app now declares itself in its own services/<app>_app.py exposing app_spec(), the registry discovers those by scanning, and the contract (AppSpec/RouterMount/store helpers) moved to services/app_spec.py. content_files 106 -> 114 is exactly the eight new app-owned declaration files; it is the legitimate upward move this baseline documents, and it buys import_sites 24 -> 18 and literal_sites 479 -> 408. app_registry.py and app_spec.py now contain ZERO app names. The frontend registry (frontend/src/apps/registry.tsx, 54 literals) is the second half and is not done.
